episodes.164985: A period of cold temperatures caused an ice jam to form on the Roaring Fork River in portions of Eagle County. Minor flooding occurred along the river with elevated river flows peaking during the late afternoon and early evening hours.
episodes.166384: A low pressure system moving across the Upper Great Lakes produced brief storm force south winds out ahead of it on the evening of the 5th at Stannard Rock Light.

events.county: Manitou Island To Marquette Mi And W Of Grand Marais Mi To Us/Canadian Border Beyond 5Nm Of Shore
events.narrative: Brief storm force south wind gusts were recorded on the evening of the 5th at Stannard Rock Light.
The USGS gage along the Roaring Fork River near Emma, Colorado showed indications of an ice jam release.
